candidates.license_evidence: Explicit article-specific statement on PDF page 1, not inferred from modern site footer.
candidates.figure_rights: No standalone approval: captions cite third-party atlases; these were not individually licensed in this task because the candidate fails clinical-purpose suitability.
candidates.reason: Figures 2–11 show aggregated lesion overlays, statistical mapping, atlas localization and disconnectome maps. They do not establish an individual diagnostic CT/MRI image of stroke.
